name: Reparameterization for Differentiable SDF Rendering
definition: A method using a reparameterization function $T$ for Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) that strictly satisfies the boundary requirement $\partial_\pi T(\omega_b, \pi) = \partial_\pi \omega_b$.
summary: Reparameterization for Differentiable SDF Rendering computes correct gradients for neural SDFs by reparameterizing the pixel integral to handle visibility discontinuities without volumetric approximations or external masks.
